interpretation_limits: Does not causally prove stronger models outperform weaker models.
Does not treat Nemotron as representative of all small or weaker models.
Does not claim model size caused the result.
Does not claim fine-tuning would necessarily improve this model.
Does not claim fine-tuning is unnecessary.
Does not claim PDB helped or hurt.
Does not treat Harness V2 as directly comparable to historical R5/R6 treatments.
Does not claim a completed matched five-task comparison of GPT-OSS and Nemotron.
